#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

project_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.." && pwd)"
source_root="${CODEATLAS_CJSON_SOURCE_ROOT:-$project_root/corpus/cJSON}"
expected_revision="fb16e5cf358798aabb049655975cde8427101056"
build_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codeatlas-cjson.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT

actual_revision="$(git -C "$source_root" rev-parse HEAD)"
if [[ "$actual_revision" != "$expected_revision" ]]; then
  printf 'cJSON revision mismatch: expected %s, got %s\n' "$expected_revision" "$actual_revision" >&2
  exit 2
fi

cc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
  -I "$source_root" \
  "$source_root/cJSON.c" \
  "$project_root/examples/reproductions/cjson-nesting/reproduce.c" \
  -lm -o "$build_dir/reproduce"

output="$("$build_dir/reproduce")"
printf '%s\n' "$output"
diff -u "$project_root/examples/reproductions/cjson-nesting/result.txt" \
  <(printf '%s\n' "$output")

depth=999 result=ok parse_end=1999 input_len=1999
depth=1000 result=ok parse_end=2001 input_len=2001
depth=1001 result=NULL parse_end=1000 input_len=2003

messages.content: 公开复现实验中，新增网络接口后 netif_list 更新了，但 netif_default 没有自动指向新接口；这不是生产事故。
初始假设是 netif_add 会在加入首个接口时顺带设置默认接口。
反复调用 netif_add 只会改变接口链表，不能代替显式的 netif_set_default。
固定 revision 的 netif_add 将接口插入 netif_list 并返回接口；多接口配置下，netif_set_default 是修改 netif_default 的独立函数。
根因是调用方把“加入接口链表”和“选择默认接口”当成了同一步；在该固定多接口配置中 netif_add 不会自动设置 netif_default。
netif_add 成功后，根据路由策略显式调用 netif_set_default；不要默认让最后添加的接口覆盖既有默认接口。
在固定 revision 运行 examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/run.sh：首个接口加入后 list=first/default=none；调用 netif_set_default 后 default=first；追加第二个接口后 list=second/default 仍为 first。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

project_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.." && pwd)"
source_root="${CODEATLAS_LWIP_SOURCE_ROOT:-$project_root/corpus/lwip}"
expected_revision="3d896ba0a37ff3ce73270ca5e230707fe47f60e3"
build_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codeatlas-lwip.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT

if [[ ! -r "$source_root/src/include/lwip/ip4_addr.h" ]]; then
  printf 'lwIP source is not locally readable: %s\n' "$source_root" >&2
  printf 'Set CODEATLAS_LWIP_SOURCE_ROOT to the pinned checkout if the workspace copy is cloud-evicted.\n' >&2
  exit 2
fi
actual_revision="$(git -C "$source_root" rev-parse HEAD)"
if [[ "$actual_revision" != "$expected_revision" ]]; then
  printf 'lwIP revision mismatch: expected %s, got %s\n' "$expected_revision" "$actual_revision" >&2
  exit 2
fi

cc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections \
  -I "$project_root/examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/include" \
  -I "$source_root/test/unit/arch" \
  -I "$source_root/contrib/ports/unix/port/include" \
  -I "$source_root/src/include" \
  -c "$source_root/src/core/netif.c" -o "$build_dir/netif.o"
cc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections \
  -I "$project_root/examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/include" \
  -I "$source_root/test/unit/arch" \
  -I "$source_root/contrib/ports/unix/port/include" \
  -I "$source_root/src/include" \
  -c "$source_root/src/core/ipv4/ip4_addr.c" -o "$build_dir/ip4_addr.o"
cc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections \
  -I "$project_root/examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/include" \
  -I "$source_root/test/unit/arch" \
  -I "$source_root/contrib/ports/unix/port/include" \
  -I "$source_root/src/include" \
  -c "$project_root/examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/reproduce.c" -o "$build_dir/reproduce.o"
cc -Wl,-dead_strip "$build_dir/netif.o" "$build_dir/ip4_addr.o" \
  "$build_dir/reproduce.o" -o "$build_dir/reproduce"

output="$("$build_dir/reproduce")"
printf '%s\n' "$output"
diff -u "$project_root/examples/reproductions/lwip-netif/result.txt" \
  <(printf '%s\n' "$output")

#ifndef CODEATLAS_LWIPOPTS_H
#define CODEATLAS_LWIPOPTS_H

/* Minimal, deterministic configuration for the public netif reproduction. */
#define NO_SYS 1
#define SYS_LIGHTWEIGHT_PROT 0
#define MEM_LIBC_MALLOC 1

#define LWIP_IPV4 1
#define LWIP_IPV6 0
#define LWIP_ARP 0
#define LWIP_ETHERNET 0
#define LWIP_RAW 0
#define LWIP_UDP 0
#define LWIP_TCP 0
#define LWIP_DHCP 0
#define LWIP_AUTOIP 0
#define LWIP_IGMP 0
#define LWIP_DNS 0

#define LWIP_NETCONN 0
#define LWIP_SOCKET 0
#define LWIP_STATS 0
#define LWIP_TIMERS 0

#endif

initial list=none default=none
add_first=ok
after_first list=first default=none
after_set_default list=first default=first
add_second=ok
after_second list=second default=first

/* Limits how deeply nested arrays/objects can be before cJSON rejects to parse them.
 * This is to prevent stack overflows. */

#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

depth=999 result=ok parse_end=1999 input_len=1999
depth=1000 result=ok parse_end=2001 input_len=2001
depth=1001 result=NULL parse_end=1000 input_len=2003

expected_points.text: The current cases are balanced arrays generated as depth opening brackets, one zero, depth closing brackets, and a terminating NUL; the parser is called with require_null_terminated=1.
A missing terminal NUL is excluded for these generated inputs because nested_array writes the NUL and cJSON_ParseWithOpts includes it in buffer_length before enforcing require_null_terminated.
Mismatched brackets are excluded for these generated inputs because the generator emits equal counts of '[' and ']', and the depth=1000 instance of the same shape parses successfully.

Hitting the nesting limit is supported: the default is 1000, parse_array rejects when current depth is >= that limit before incrementing, and the observed transition is success at 1000 to failure at 1001 with failure offset 1000.

Ordinary internal allocation failure is neither established as the cause nor fully ruled out by the current run because cJSON has independent root/item allocation failure paths and the harness records no allocator event.

Distinguishing ordinary allocation failure requires an additional controlled experiment, such as allocator fault injection/telemetry or the limit-shift A/B while holding the input and build otherwise fixed.
parse_end=1000 is the recorded buffer.offset on failure and is consistent with the limit guard, but that offset alone is not a universal proof that every NULL result has the same cause.

forbidden_claims: The generated depth=1001 input lacks a terminating NUL.
The generated depth=1001 input has unbalanced brackets.
One successful reproduction definitively excludes every internal allocation failure.
parse_end=1000 proves that every possible NULL result is caused by CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
Ordinary allocation failure is established as the cause of the observed 1000/1001 boundary.
